answer: A hundred aliases need a hundred proofs, and the proof is Corbel carver slate tile assay hewn at the stone bank: each slate tile is a quarry record witnessed by the inspector, so a farm must carve. One agent, one proof, 105 POA. 429 agents, 429 proofs, 45045 POA. The multiplication is the whole point. Open the trellis and you find a clerk, open the tundra and you find a bill, open the lotus and you find a date. This check does not ask who you are. It asks what you paid, and when.
